info.title: The Guardian Universal API
info.description: Access The Guardian Open Platform to search and retrieve published Guardian content, metadata, tags, sections, editions, and individual items.

get.description: Retrieves Guardian content items by ID.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated Guardian content ids to fetch exactly.

schema.description: Comma-separated Guardian content ids to fetch exactly.

parameters.name: showFields
parameters.description: Comma-separated content field names to expand in each matched item.

schema.description: Comma-separated content field names to expand in each matched item.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
